facts.text: The user requested a list reduced to 5 names total, including Vanessa Fong.
The user said there were Chinese names that were missing Chinese characters or (characters unknown) and asked to fix that.
The user requested a table just for Vanessa Fong.
The user requested a table about the books published by Vanessa Fong.
The user specified the table column titles to include title, publisher name, year published, number of pages, major idea #1, major idea #2, similar theorist, and contrarian theorists.
The user requested that the similar theorists include names of one or more theorists, including the names of books of theirs and quotes from those books showing agreement.
The user requested that the contrarian theorists include names of one or more theorists, including the names of books of theirs and quotes from those books showing disagreement.
